description: Achieve 90%+ test coverage across all services with unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests. Implement automated CI/CD pipeline with linting, security scanning, performance testing, and automated deployment. Add property-based testing for critical business logic, contract testing for service boundaries, and chaos engineering for fault tolerance verification.
workflow_rationale: This is a feature implementation that spans multiple services (frontend, backend, microservices). The workflow follows service dependency order: establish test infrastructure first (setup), then build testing capabilities for each service layer (implementation), and finally integrate everything with CI/CD automation (integration). This ensures each service can be tested independently before being wired together.
